entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: An ogre o-bakemono shaman from Kamigawa, master of blood and fire magic and devout worshipper of the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos, who later merges with the oni.

entities.name: All-Consuming Oni of Chaos
entities.description: The oni overlord Hidetsugu worships, torn in two by O-Kagachi and later devoured by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where Hidetsugu lives.

entities.name: Sokenzan
entities.description: The mountain range where Hidetsugu lives in a cave dwelling named Shinka.

entities.name: Uramon
entities.description: A ruler from Numai who sent a task force to eliminate Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A kanji mage who survives Hidetsugu's attack and persuades him to form the Hyozan Reckoners.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: A reckoner gang formed by Hidetsugu and Toshi through a blood and kanji magic oath.

entities.name: Kobo
entities.description: An ex-budoka who becomes Hidetsugu's apprentice, is made part of the hyozan, and is killed by Choryu.

entities.name: Choryu
entities.description: A Minamo wizard who killed Kobo and was tortured by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: The wizards' academy that Hidetsugu assaults and destroys.

entities.name: Keiga
entities.description: A figure defeated by Hidetsugu and his hunters at Minamo.

entities.name: Hisoka
entities.description: A figure killed in the destruction of the Academy.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The home of the soratami, attacked by Hidetsugu's oni army.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: A hyozan who stabs Hidetsugu in the eye to save Toshi and Kiku.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: A hyozan with a mahotsukai-imposed curse who fights and is defeated by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: A being drawn to Minamo that tears the All-Consuming Oni in two.

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description: A figure torn apart and consumed by Hidetsugu after his return.

entities.name: Sisters of Flesh and Spirit
entities.description: Beings who ascend after O-Kagachi's destruction and with whom Hidetsugu claims an alliance.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The being who personally intervenes to imprison Hidetsugu in the spirit realm.

entities.name: Kairi
entities.description: A cool-headed spirit dragon, reincarnation of the dragon Hidetsugu slew, who frees him to help defend Kamigawa from the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Kamigawa for which Kairi enlists Hidetsugu's help.

events.summary: Hidetsugu kills Boss Uramon's task force except Toshiro Umezawa, whom he agrees to form the Hyozan Reckoners with.
events.quote: Hidetsugu killed all the men except Umezawa

events.summary: After a long search Hidetsugu finds a worthy apprentice in Kobo.
events.quote: he found a worthy apprentice in the ex-budoka Kobo

events.summary: Hidetsugu and Toshi perform a ritual making Kobo part of the hyozan, and send him to Jukai.
events.quote: together they performed the ritual which made Kobo part of the hyozan

events.summary: Kobo is killed by Choryu; Hidetsugu tortures Choryu for months.
events.quote: Kobo was killed by the Minamo wizard Choryu

events.summary: Hidetsugu vows total revenge for Kobo's death and kills yamabushi who refuse to help him.
events.quote: Hidetsugu vowed to exact total revenge on anybody responsible for Kobo's death

events.summary: Hidetsugu assaults Minamo, defeats Keiga, destroys the Academy and summons the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
events.quote: destroyed the Academy, and killed almost everyone inside

events.summary: Hidetsugu unleashes his oni army on Otawara, and Toshi declares war on him.
events.quote: Toshi openly declared a war between the two founding members of the hyozan

events.summary: Hidetsugu nearly kills Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and Toshi stabs the other.
events.quote: Toshi used Hidetsugu's momentary distraction and stabbed his remaining eye.

events.summary: O-Kagachi tears the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos in two, and Hidetsugu asks Toshi to transport him to the oni's honden.
events.quote: the oni overlord was almost effortlessly torn in two by O-Kagachi

events.summary: Hidetsugu returns with restored eyes, merged with the All-Consuming into a being like the Sisters, and consumes Mochi.
events.quote: tearing Mochi into pieces before consuming him

events.summary: Hidetsugu devours the failed oni, becomes the most formidable demonic entity, and is imprisoned in the spirit realm by Kyodai.
events.quote: His cruelties and the destruction he wreaked throughout the land caused Kyodai to personally intervene and imprison him in the spirit realm

events.summary: Kairi frees Hidetsugu from the spirit realm to help fight the Phyrexian Invasion; Hidetsugu agrees.
events.quote: Hidetsugu agreed to fight alongside the dragon.

relations.note: A devout worshipper, later turned on it.
relations.quote: a devout worshipper of the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos
he found a worthy apprentice in the ex-budoka Kobo
Kobo was killed by the Minamo wizard Choryu

relations.note: Formed the Hyozan Reckoners, later declared war.
relations.quote: persuaded him to form a new reckoner gang
clashed with All-Consuming Oni of Chaos

relations.note: Reincarnation of the dragon he slew; allied for now.
relations.quote: Kairi will seize the opportunity to lock him up once again

relations.note: Imprisoned him in the spirit realm.
relations.quote: imprison him in the spirit realm
